title: Battle of Kafer Qal'eh
summary: The English Wikipedia article "Battle of Kafer Qal'eh", at revision 1378916177, opens: "The Battle of Kafer Qal'eh was a series of clashes which decided the outcome to the Herat Campaign. In its culminating stage the battle bears some resemblances to the battle of Sangan although it was both preceded and succeeded by numerous other minor skirmishes and engagements." That is the article's account and not yet this atlas's; nobody has read this record, and review.html is where somebody does. Wikidata item Q18162684, imported by tools/import/wikidata.mjs. The item's own description reads "series of 1729 battles". Everything here is copied from the item's own fields and nothing in it is this atlas's account of the thing: that is still to be written, and review.html is where somebody writes it.
